llms.body:
# Pushnami

> Pushnami is an AI-first performance marketing company based in Austin, Texas. It owns and operates about 30 consumer websites that bring in more than 120,000 US registrations a day, and its push technology runs on more than 1,000 publisher websites. Its AI engine, Pushnomics, matches those consumers to advertisers as leads, live transfers, and push and SMS traffic. Founded in 2017, Pushnami is founder-owned, has never taken outside funding, and has been profitable since day one.

## Key facts

- Founded: 2017, Austin, Texas
- Ownership: 100% founder-owned. No outside funding. Profitable from day one.
- Owned websites: About 30 websites we own and operate
- Publisher websites: 1,000+ publisher websites run Pushnami push
- Registrations: 120,000+ US consumer registrations a day, on our owned websites
- Messages: 10 billion messages a month
- AI engine: Pushnomics. Picks the offer and the send time for each subscriber.
- Patents: 4 issued US patents
- Team: A team of 20. 100% AI-generated code (September 2026).
- Awards: Best Place to Work in Austin, 2019 to 2025. Inc. 5000, 2021 and 2024.
- Quality: Consent certificates delivered with leads. Fraud and bot screening before delivery. Advertiser suppression lists honored.
- Reply time: We reply within 1 business day
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/pushnami/

## Advertisers

- [Leads](https://pushnami.com/advertisers/leads/): consumer leads with consent, matched to your offer
- [Live transfers](https://pushnami.com/advertisers/live-transfers/): consumers qualified by our AI call center and connected live
- [Push and SMS traffic](https://pushnami.com/advertisers/push-and-sms/): opted-in subscribers across publisher websites
- [Industries](https://pushnami.com/industries/): insurance, Medicare, final expense, home services, automotive, legal, financial services, real estate

## Publishers

- [Earn with push notifications](https://pushnami.com/publishers/push/) (Push Managed Services): we run push on your site and share the revenue
- [Push notification software](https://pushnami.com/publishers/push-enterprise/) (Push Enterprise): send your own notifications through our admin
- [Pay per lead program](https://pushnami.com/publishers/pay-per-lead/) (Pivot): a pay per lead affiliate program

## Run ads from AI assistants

- [Pushnami Ads MCP server](https://pushnami.com/advertisers/ai-assistants/): Pushnami Ads MCP server is live. Advertisers use it from AI assistants to check balances, upload creatives, and create campaigns.

## Company

- [About](https://pushnami.com/about-us/)
- [How it works](https://pushnami.com/how-it-works/): Pushnomics, our AI engine
- [Lead quality](https://pushnami.com/quality/)
- [Consumer brands](https://pushnami.com/brands/)
- [Careers](https://pushnami.com/careers/)
- [Contact](https://pushnami.com/contact-us/)
- [Privacy center](https://pushnami.com/privacy/)
